[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Charger''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who commanded his own unit, [[Charger's Irregulars]]. A small but effective unit, the Irregulars specialized in brushfire wars and hot spot conflicts. In combat, Charger was a tightly wound commander, shouting orders and commands. Out of combat, Charger was soft-spoken and polite. While the Irregulars were exclusively [[Human/Legends|Human]], Charger had no qualms about working with [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] although he found it easier to command beings of his own species.<ref name="PSG" />
